mineral_streak_tests.observation: Prospectors scratch a mineral across an unglazed tile and name it by the colour of its powder.

vegetation_zone_mapping.name: Vegetation Zones
vegetation_zone_mapping.observation: Travelling naturalists chart how forest gives way to scrub, meadow and snow with height and with distance from the equator.

sediment_provenance.observation: Sand grains and pebbles in a river bar are matched to the hills they were worn from, and the prospector follows them upstream.

forestry_academy.name: Forestry Academy
forestry_academy.observation: Students at the forestry academy measure trunks and count rings to reckon how much wood a stand adds each year.
forestry_academy.ability_reason: Trained foresters measure how much wood a forest grows each year and cut no more than that, so timber can be planned across generations.
forestry_academy.social_consequence: Villagers lose their customary rights to gather wood and graze in forests run by the academy's graduates.

comparative_mineral_hardness.observation: A ladder of minerals, each scratching the one below, lets any prospector rank a stone's hardness in the field.

lithologic_correlation.observation: The same fossil shells in quarries a day's ride apart show that the beds are one stratum, and a coal seam can be followed underground.

geologic_cross_sections.observation: Surveyors draw the strata as a slice through the hills, from what the mine shafts and canal cuttings expose.

structural_geologic_mapping.observation: A great coloured map shows every stratum of the realm, bed by bed, from the coast to the mountains.
structural_geologic_mapping.ability_reason: A map of the whole realm's strata shows where coal, ore and water lie, so mines and wells are sunk where they will pay.

isotherm_maps.name: Isotherm Maps
isotherm_maps.observation: Lines drawn through places of equal mean warmth wander across the map, and the climates of distant lands can be compared.

tall_dispersal_stacks.name: Tall Works Chimneys
tall_dispersal_stacks.observation: Works chimneys rise taller than any church tower, so that the smoke falls on someone else's fields.
tall_dispersal_stacks.social_consequence: The fumes fall on distant farms instead of the works' own street, and the quarrel moves with them.

atmospheric_heat_retention.name: Heat-Holding Air
atmospheric_heat_retention.observation: A natural philosopher argues that the air, like the glass of a hothouse, holds in the warmth the earth receives from the sun.

acid_fume_blight.name: Acid Fume Blight
acid_fume_blight.observation: Downwind of the alkali works, hedges blacken and the wheat withers, and the farmers go to law.
acid_fume_blight.social_consequence: Farmers and works owners fight each other in the courts for a generation.

state_forest_code.name: State Forest Code
state_forest_code.observation: The forest code puts the village woods under state foresters, who mark each tree that may be felled.
state_forest_code.social_consequence: Villagers who gathered wood for generations are fined as thieves.

developmental_stage_series.observation: Embryos of fish, bird and beast laid side by side look alike at first and diverge stage by stage.

gasworks_river_waste.name: Gasworks Waste
gasworks_river_waste.observation: Tar and spent lime from the gasworks drain into the town river, and the fish float belly-up below the outfall.

realm_geological_survey.name: Realm Geological Survey
realm_geological_survey.observation: A standing survey office sends its geologists into every district and publishes a sheet for each.
realm_geological_survey.ability_reason: A standing office maps coal, ore, clay and water for the whole realm, so the state knows its mineral wealth and where to dig.

soil_assays.observation: Chemists burn and weigh soils to find which plant foods they hold and which they lack.

ice_age_theory.name: Ice Age Theory
ice_age_theory.observation: Scratched bedrock and great boulders far from their home hills show that ice once covered the northern lands.
ice_age_theory.ability_reason: Scholars learn that the climate has changed utterly in the past, so boulders, lakes and soils can be read as a record of ages of great cold.

colony_hunting_collapse.name: Colony Collapse
colony_hunting_collapse.observation: The sealers and egg-gatherers return to the rookeries and find bare rock where millions once bred.
colony_hunting_collapse.social_consequence: Coastal families who lived by the harvest lose it for good.

telegraphed_weather_maps.name: Telegraphed Weather Maps
telegraphed_weather_maps.observation: Readings telegraphed from a hundred stations at the same hour are drawn as one map, and the storm is seen as it forms.
telegraphed_weather_maps.ability_reason: Reports telegraphed from many stations show storms as they form, so ports and farms can be warned before the weather arrives.

fish_hatcheries.name: Fish Hatcheries
fish_hatcheries.observation: Spawn stripped from caught fish is hatched in troughs and the fry are released into rivers emptied by mills and nets.

smoke_nuisance_ordinances.name: Smoke Ordinances
smoke_nuisance_ordinances.observation: Furnace inspectors walk the works streets and fine every chimney that pours black smoke for more than a few minutes.

acclimatization_societies.name: Acclimatization Societies
acclimatization_societies.observation: Gentlemen's societies release foreign songbirds, deer and trout into the countryside to improve on nature.

heat_trapping_gases.name: Heat-Trapping Gases
heat_trapping_gases.observation: In the laboratory, a tube of carbonic acid gas and a tube of water vapour are shown to stop the passage of radiant heat.

invasive_species_spread.name: Invasive Species
invasive_species_spread.observation: Rabbits released for sport strip the pastures bare, and imported weeds choke fields across the new lands.
invasive_species_spread.social_consequence: Graziers are ruined in drought years, and bounties and poisons spread across the land.

harbour_storm_warnings.name: Harbour Storm Warnings
harbour_storm_warnings.observation: A cone hoisted on the harbour mast warns fishermen of the gale the telegraph says is coming.

fume_works_inspectorate.name: Fume Works Inspectorate
fume_works_inspectorate.observation: Inspectors test the air at the chimneys of the acid works, and every works must pass its fumes through a condensing tower.
fume_works_inspectorate.ability_reason: Works must condense their acid fumes and inspectors can prove and stop the worst emissions, so the first industrial pollution is brought under control.
fume_works_inspectorate.social_consequence: Works owners resent the inspectors, and the cost of the towers is passed on in prices.

human_impact_treatise.name: Treatise on Human Impact
human_impact_treatise.observation: A traveller's treatise shows how clearing, draining and grazing have turned green lands to desert and silted their harbours.
human_impact_treatise.ability_reason: Clearing, draining and grazing are shown to change climate, rivers and soil, so rulers and landowners can weigh the damage before they act.

household_of_nature_science.name: Ecology Named
household_of_nature_science.observation: Naturalists name a new science for the study of living things in their household of soil, water, prey and rivals.

lichen_air_indicators.name: Lichen Air Signs
lichen_air_indicators.observation: Lichens that grow thickly on country walls are missing near the towns, and naturalists read their absence as a sign of foul air.

state_weather_service.name: State Weather Service
state_weather_service.observation: A state office prints the weather forecast each morning, and the newspapers carry it to every farm.
state_weather_service.ability_reason: Daily forecasts warn farmers, fishermen and generals alike of the next day's weather, so harvests and sailings can be timed to it.

reserved_nature_park.name: Great Nature Park
reserved_nature_park.observation: A great tract of geysers, forest and canyon is set apart by law, never to be sold or settled.
reserved_nature_park.ability_reason: Wild land is protected by law for ever, so its forests, herds and waters recover and remain a reservoir of wild life.
reserved_nature_park.social_consequence: The hunters and herders who used the land are removed from it.

tree_planting_days.name: Tree-Planting Days
tree_planting_days.observation: On the treeless plains a day is set aside each spring when every school and farm plants trees and shelterbelts.

river_pollution_act.name: River Pollution Act
river_pollution_act.observation: A law forbids works and towns to pour solid and poisonous refuse into the rivers, though the fines are small.

biogeographic_realms.name: Animal Realms of the World
biogeographic_realms.observation: Naturalists divide the world into great realms by their animals and find a sharp line between two islands a strait apart.

fish_ladder_requirements.name: Fish Ladders
fish_ladder_requirements.observation: Every new dam and weir must have a stepped ladder of pools so that the salmon can climb past it.

smoke_damage_leaf_assays.name: Smoke Damage Assays
smoke_damage_leaf_assays.observation: Chemists measure the sulphur in the leaves of blighted trees, and the works that caused it pay damages in court.

volcanic_dust_cooling.name: Volcanic Dust
volcanic_dust_cooling.observation: After a great eruption the sunsets burn red around the world, and the following summer is cold.

bird_protection_societies.name: Bird Protection Societies
bird_protection_societies.observation: Societies of ladies refuse to wear hats trimmed with egret plumes and campaign to end the plume trade.

relict_herd_protection.name: Relict Herd Protection
relict_herd_protection.observation: The last few hundred of the wild herds that once covered the plains are counted and guarded in a park.

state_forest_reserves.name: State Forest Reserves
state_forest_reserves.observation: Great tracts of mountain forest are withdrawn from sale and held by the state.

irrigation_salinization.name: Salted Irrigation Land
irrigation_salinization.observation: Canal-watered fields turn white with salt as the water table rises, and harvests fall year by year.
irrigation_salinization.social_consequence: Farmers abandon land their grandfathers watered, and the canal districts shrink.

game_warden_licences.name: Game Wardens
game_warden_licences.observation: Hunters buy a licence, keep to a season and a bag limit, and wardens enforce them in the woods.

fossil_carbon_warming_estimate.name: Coal Warming Estimate
fossil_carbon_warming_estimate.observation: A chemist works out by hand that the coal the world burns will, over centuries, warm it.
fossil_carbon_warming_estimate.ability_reason: Scholars calculate that burning coal adds enough gas to the air to warm the world, so the long cost of the steam age can at last be counted.

smoke_density_charts.name: Smoke Density Charts
smoke_density_charts.observation: An inspector holds a printed card of greys up to a chimney and records the density of the smoke.

plant_succession.name: Plant Succession
plant_succession.observation: On shifting dunes, a botanist traces how grasses give way to shrubs and then forest over the years.

systematic_channel_sampling.observation: Samplers cut measured channels across the ore face and assay each one, so the grade of the body can be mapped.

wildlife_refuges.name: Wildlife Refuges
wildlife_refuges.observation: Islands, marshes and lakes are proclaimed refuges where no bird may be shot.

state_forest_service.name: State Forest Service
state_forest_service.observation: Uniformed rangers patrol the state forests, fight fires and sell timber by plan.
state_forest_service.ability_reason: Rangers replant, fight fire and sell timber by plan, so the forests are harvested without being destroyed.
state_forest_service.social_consequence: Loggers and graziers resent the rangers' rules on land they had always used freely.

resource_conservation_policy.name: Conservation Policy
resource_conservation_policy.observation: The governors of every province meet at the capital and agree that forests, soils, water and minerals must be husbanded.

forest_fire_suppression.name: Total Fire Suppression
forest_fire_suppression.observation: Every forest fire is to be put out by ten the next morning, and the fire crews are proud that none burns long.
forest_fire_suppression.social_consequence: The undergrowth thickens year after year, and the fires that finally escape are worse than any before.

pelagic_sealing_treaty.name: Sealing Treaty
pelagic_sealing_treaty.observation: The realms agree to end the killing of seals on the open sea and to share the take on the breeding islands.

continental_drift_hypothesis.name: Drifting Continents
continental_drift_hypothesis.observation: A scholar argues that the coasts on either side of the ocean fit like torn pages, and that the continents have moved apart.

human_caused_extinction.name: Extinction by Hunting
human_caused_extinction.observation: The last bird of a kind that once darkened the sky dies in a menagerie, and naturalists admit that hunting did it.

migratory_bird_treaty.name: Migratory Bird Treaty
migratory_bird_treaty.observation: Realms on both ends of a flyway agree to protect the birds that winter in one and nest in the other.

park_service_office.name: Park Service
park_service_office.observation: A park service with its own rangers runs the nature parks, their roads, lodges and campgrounds.

range_carrying_capacity.name: Range Carrying Capacity
range_carrying_capacity.observation: Range surveyors measure how many head of stock each section of grassland can feed without being grazed bare.

population_dynamics_equations.name: Population Equations
population_dynamics_equations.observation: Mathematicians write equations for how a population grows and how predators and prey rise and fall in turn.

oil_discharge_limits.name: Oil Discharge Limits
oil_discharge_limits.observation: Ships may no longer pump oily bilge within sight of the coast.

food_chain_pyramids.name: Food Chain Pyramids
food_chain_pyramids.observation: Ecologists count the plants, grazers and hunters in a pond and find each level far fewer than the one below.

plains_dust_storms.name: Dust Storms
plains_dust_storms.observation: Black clouds of topsoil roll off the dry-ploughed plains and bury farmhouses to the windowsills.
plains_dust_storms.social_consequence: Ruined farm families pack up what they own and head for the cities.

public_grazing_districts.name: Grazing Districts
public_grazing_districts.observation: The public range is divided into grazing districts, with permits and a limit on the stock each may carry.

ecosystem_concept.name: The Ecosystem
ecosystem_concept.observation: An ecologist names the living things and their soil, water and air together as one system.
ecosystem_concept.ability_reason: Living things and their setting are understood as one system, so the knock-on effects of draining, spraying or damming can be predicted before they are done.

earthquake_magnitude_scale.name: Earthquake Magnitude
earthquake_magnitude_scale.observation: A seismologist grades every earthquake by the size of the trace it leaves on a standard instrument.

measured_carbon_warming.name: Measured Warming
measured_carbon_warming.observation: Weather records from a hundred stations show the world has warmed as the burning of fuel has risen.

trophic_energy_flow.name: Energy Flow
trophic_energy_flow.observation: An ecologist measures how much of the sun's energy each feeding level of a lake passes to the next.

whaling_quota_commission.name: Whaling Commission
whaling_quota_commission.observation: A commission of realms sets yearly whaling quotas, though the quotas are set by the whaling nations and fall far short of protecting the whales.

nature_union_red_lists.name: Red Lists
nature_union_red_lists.observation: A union of naturalists from many realms keeps a list of every species in danger and how close it is to the end.

grade_tonnage_models.observation: Tables of grade against tonnage for known ore bodies show how much metal a new discovery is likely to hold.

numerical_weather_prediction.name: Computed Forecasts
numerical_weather_prediction.observation: An electronic calculating machine solves the equations of the atmosphere, and tomorrow's weather map is printed before tomorrow comes.
numerical_weather_prediction.ability_reason: Forecasts computed on electronic machines see days ahead, so harvests, shipping, airlifts and landings are timed to the weather with real confidence.

killer_smog_episode.name: Killing Smog
killer_smog_episode.observation: A still winter fog mixes with coal smoke over the capital; for five days no one can see across the street, and thousands die.
killer_smog_episode.social_consequence: The public finally demands clean air, and the coal hearth becomes a political question.

sustainable_yield_fisheries.name: Sustainable Yield
sustainable_yield_fisheries.observation: Fishery scientists calculate the largest catch a stock can bear year after year, and quotas are set to it, often too high.

fallout_monitoring.name: Fallout Monitoring
fallout_monitoring.observation: Stations around the world collect rain and dust and count the radioactivity from the weapon tests.

clean_air_act.name: Clean Air Act
clean_air_act.observation: Smokeless zones are declared in the towns, and coal fires in them must burn coke or be replaced.
clean_air_act.ability_reason: Smokeless zones and chimney controls clear the town air of coal smoke and winter smogs end, at the price of new fuels and new grates.
clean_air_act.social_consequence: Every household must buy smokeless fuel or new grates, and poor families feel the cost.

industrial_mercury_poisoning.name: Mercury Poisoning
industrial_mercury_poisoning.observation: Fishing families in a coastal town sicken and shake, and the cause is found in the mercury from a factory's waste pipe.
industrial_mercury_poisoning.social_consequence: The victims' long fight for compensation shames the firm and the officials who protected it.

atmospheric_co2_record.name: Carbon Dioxide Record
atmospheric_co2_record.observation: Instruments on a high mountain record the carbon dioxide in the air every hour, and the line climbs year by year.
atmospheric_co2_record.ability_reason: A continuous record shows carbon dioxide rising every year, so climate forcing is measured rather than guessed.

weather_satellites.name: Weather Satellites
weather_satellites.observation: Satellites photograph the cloud over half the world at once, and no storm at sea goes unseen.

persistent_pesticide_warning.name: Persistent Pesticide Warning
persistent_pesticide_warning.observation: Songbirds vanish from the sprayed countryside, and the poisons are found in fish, eagles and mothers' milk.
persistent_pesticide_warning.ability_reason: Persistent pesticides are shown to kill birds and build up in food chains; the worst are withdrawn, protecting wildlife and people at a cost to harvests.
persistent_pesticide_warning.social_consequence: Farmers and chemical firms protest the loss of their cheapest sprays.

spatial_variograms.observation: Assays from drill holes are compared pair by pair to show how far apart two samples can be and still predict each other.

resource_kriging.observation: Ore grades between drill holes are estimated by weighting nearby assays according to the variogram.

orebody_block_models.observation: The ore body is divided into blocks on a computer, each with its estimated grade, and the mine plan follows them.

geochemical_baselines.observation: Stream sediments and soils are sampled across the realm to record their natural metal content before new mines disturb it.

plate_tectonics.name: Plate Tectonics
plate_tectonics.observation: Magnetic stripes on the sea floor prove that the ocean crust spreads from the mid-ocean ridges and the continents ride on moving plates.

endangered_species_list.name: Endangered Species Law
endangered_species_list.observation: The law lists every species in danger, and no public work may push one closer to extinction.
endangered_species_list.social_consequence: A dam or a logging road halted for a small fish or an owl becomes a national quarrel.

island_biogeography.name: Island Biogeography
island_biogeography.observation: Ecologists show that small, distant islands hold fewer species than large, near ones, and that reserves behave like islands.

oil_spill_response.name: Oil Spill Response
oil_spill_response.observation: After a tanker breaks up on the rocks, booms, skimmers and volunteers try to save the beaches and birds.

environmental_impact_review.name: Environmental Impact Review
environmental_impact_review.observation: Every road, dam and power station must first publish a study of the harm it will do to land, water and wildlife.
environmental_impact_review.ability_reason: Every public work must weigh its harm to land, water and wildlife before it begins, so the worst damage is avoided, though projects take years longer.
environmental_impact_review.social_consequence: Builders and councils complain of delay, and neighbours gain a voice against the roads and dams.

environment_protection_agency.name: Environmental Protection Agency
environment_protection_agency.observation: One agency sets limits for air, water and waste across the realm, and its inspectors can close a works that breaks them.
environment_protection_agency.ability_reason: One agency sets and enforces limits on air, water and waste pollution across the realm, backed by inspectors and fines.
environment_protection_agency.social_consequence: Industry pays for scrubbers and treatment plants, and some works close rather than comply.

geochemical_anomaly_mapping.observation: Maps of metal traces in stream sediments show anomalies that lead the prospectors to buried ore.

wetland_convention.name: Wetland Convention
wetland_convention.observation: The realms list their great marshes and estuaries and promise to keep them for the waterfowl.

interrealm_environment_programme.name: Environment Programme
interrealm_environment_programme.observation: The world assembly sets up an environment programme to watch over the shared seas and air.

earth_observation_satellites.name: Earth Observation Satellites
earth_observation_satellites.observation: Satellites image every field and forest on earth every few weeks, and the clearing of a forest can be watched from orbit.

endangered_trade_convention.name: Endangered Trade Convention
endangered_trade_convention.observation: Ivory, furs and live animals of threatened kinds may cross borders only with a permit.

ozone_depletion_theory.name: Ozone Depletion Theory
ozone_depletion_theory.observation: Chemists show that the chlorinated gases used in refrigerators and spray cans rise to the upper air and destroy its ozone.

leaded_fuel_phaseout.name: Leaded Fuel Phase-Out
leaded_fuel_phaseout.observation: Petrol sold at the pump must be free of lead, and the lead in children's blood begins to fall.

transboundary_acid_rain.name: Acid Rain
transboundary_acid_rain.observation: The lakes of a neighbouring realm turn clear and lifeless, and their forests die back, from the smoke of power stations far away.
transboundary_acid_rain.social_consequence: The neighbouring realm demands that the polluters pay, and relations sour.

climate_circulation_models.name: Climate Models
climate_circulation_models.observation: Models of the air and oceans on large computers test what doubling carbon dioxide would do to the world.

transboundary_air_convention.name: Air Pollution Convention
transboundary_air_convention.observation: The realms agree to measure and cut the smoke that crosses their borders.

polluter_pays_cleanup.name: Polluter-Pays Cleanup
polluter_pays_cleanup.observation: Leaking drums are dug out of a poisoned housing estate, and the firm that buried them is made to pay.
polluter_pays_cleanup.social_consequence: Cleanups cost fortunes and take decades, and the firms fight every bill in court.

whaling_moratorium.name: Whaling Moratorium
whaling_moratorium.observation: The whaling commission votes to end all commercial whaling, and the harpoon fleets are laid up.

polar_ozone_hole.name: Polar Ozone Hole
polar_ozone_hole.observation: Instruments at the pole show the ozone over it vanishing each spring, a hole larger than a continent.

reactor_fallout_crisis.name: Reactor Fallout Crisis
reactor_fallout_crisis.observation: A reactor explodes and spreads fallout across several realms, and whole districts are evacuated and fenced off.
reactor_fallout_crisis.social_consequence: A district is abandoned for generations, and trust in the state's word collapses.

ozone_protection_treaty.name: Ozone Protection Treaty
ozone_protection_treaty.observation: The realms agree to phase out the gases that destroy ozone and to pay poorer realms to switch.
ozone_protection_treaty.ability_reason: The gases thinning the ozone layer are phased out by treaty, so the shield against burning sunlight begins to recover; the substitute refrigerants cost more.

deep_ice_core_records.name: Deep Ice Cores
deep_ice_core_records.observation: Cores drilled two miles into the polar ice hold bubbles of ancient air that record temperature and carbon dioxide for hundreds of thousands of years.

climate_assessment_panel.name: Climate Assessment Panel
climate_assessment_panel.observation: Scientists from every realm meet to sum up what is known about warming, and their report is agreed line by line with the governments.
climate_assessment_panel.ability_reason: Scientists of every realm agree on what is known about warming, so rulers must answer for climate forcing on shared evidence.

sulfur_allowance_trading.name: Sulphur Allowance Trading
sulfur_allowance_trading.observation: Power stations are issued permits for their sulphur smoke and may sell what they do not use, and emissions fall faster than required.

climate_framework_convention.name: Climate Framework Convention
climate_framework_convention.observation: The realms sign a convention to stabilize the heat-trapping gases, but set no binding limits.
climate_framework_convention.ability_reason: The realms commit themselves to stabilizing the heat-trapping gases; it binds them to report and to act, but sets no limits, so warming continues.

biodiversity_convention.name: Biodiversity Convention
biodiversity_convention.observation: The realms agree to conserve their species and habitats and to share fairly what is gained from them.

predator_reintroduction.name: Predator Reintroduction
predator_reintroduction.observation: Wolves are released into a great park, and within a few years the elk move, the willows return and the rivers change course.
predator_reintroduction.social_consequence: Ranchers near the park hate the returned wolves and demand compensation for lost stock.

binding_emission_targets.name: Binding Emission Targets
binding_emission_targets.observation: The rich realms accept binding cuts in their emissions, though the largest emitters stay outside.

ocean_plastic_gyres.name: Ocean Plastic Gyres
ocean_plastic_gyres.observation: Sailors crossing a remote ocean find it littered for a thousand miles with floating plastic fragments.

persistent_fluorochemicals.name: Forever Chemicals
persistent_fluorochemicals.observation: Fluorinated chemicals from non-stick pans and firefighting foam are found in the blood of nearly everyone and in the water they drink.
persistent_fluorochemicals.social_consequence: Towns near the factories sue, and water works must buy costly filters.

microplastic_monitoring.name: Microplastic Monitoring
microplastic_monitoring.observation: Samplers sieve seawater, soil and table salt and count plastic fragments smaller than a grain of sand.

carbon_emission_market.name: Carbon Emission Market
carbon_emission_market.observation: Power stations and factories must hold an allowance for every ton of carbon dioxide they emit, bought and sold on a market.
carbon_emission_market.ability_reason: Every ton of carbon dioxide emitted needs an allowance, so industry pays for its climate forcing and the cheapest cuts are made first.
carbon_emission_market.social_consequence: Energy prices rise, and heavy industry threatens to move abroad.

environmental_dna_surveys.name: Environmental DNA Surveys
environmental_dna_surveys.observation: A bottle of river water holds enough traces of DNA to list the fish, frogs and otters living upstream.

climate_adaptation_plans.name: Climate Adaptation Plans
climate_adaptation_plans.observation: Coastal towns raise their sea walls, cities plant shade trees and plan cooling centres against heatwaves.
climate_adaptation_plans.social_consequence: Money spent on sea walls and drains is money not spent on schools and housing.

extreme_event_attribution.name: Extreme Event Attribution
extreme_event_attribution.observation: Scientists calculate that a deadly heatwave was made several times more likely by the warming, and the toll of the forcing is counted.

universal_climate_pledges.name: Universal Climate Pledges
universal_climate_pledges.observation: Every realm pledges its own emission cuts and reports its progress every five years.
universal_climate_pledges.ability_reason: Every realm pledges and reports its own cuts, so the whole world begins to reduce climate forcing, though the pledges fall short of what is needed.

net_zero_statutes.name: Net-Zero Statutes
net_zero_statutes.observation: The realm writes into law a date by which it will emit no more carbon than it removes.

methane_plume_satellites.name: Methane Plume Satellites
methane_plume_satellites.observation: Satellites spot plumes of methane leaking from gas fields and landfills, and the operators are named.

thirty_percent_protection.name: Thirty Percent Protection
thirty_percent_protection.observation: The realms agree to set aside nearly a third of their land and sea as protected areas.
thirty_percent_protection.social_consequence: Fishers and farmers at the edge of the new reserves lose ground and income.

loss_damage_fund.name: Loss and Damage Fund
loss_damage_fund.observation: The rich realms pay into a fund for the poorer realms hardest hit by storms, droughts and rising seas.

verified_carbon_removal.name: Verified Carbon Removal
verified_carbon_removal.observation: Carbon drawn from the air and buried deep underground is measured, verified and sold as a credit.

natural_capital_accounts.name: Natural Capital Accounts
natural_capital_accounts.observation: The realm's ledgers count the value of its forests, wetlands and fisheries beside its roads and factories.

plastics_production_cap.name: Plastics Production Cap
plastics_production_cap.observation: A treaty caps the making of new plastic, and firms scramble for substitutes.
